text:
jess (Support): Heads up — multiple customers reporting chart tiles failing to load in Console. Seeing 500s from analytics-gateway when hitting /v1/metrics. Examples across different orgs.
anya (PGM): Which orgs and time ranges? any common filters? screenshots? :eyes:
jess (Support): Org ids: org-332, org-117, org-901. Time range: last 7d default, they click 1h. Repro: open dashboard -> tiles spinner forever. Network shows 500: {"error":"internal"} for analytics query.
ingest-bot: alert: analytics-gateway error-rate > 5% over 5m for prod-cluster-a (rule: gateway-5xx-rate).
kai (Eng): @marco any deploys or config changes to analytics-gateway in the last hour?
marco (Infra): There was a hotfix ~18m ago to bump DB connection pool limits to address timeouts. Rolling back now to confirm.
jess (Support): Pasted minimal reproduce curl from a user's session: ```curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 'https://console.redwood.ai/analytics/v1/query?range=1h'``` Response: `HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error` and body: {"error":"timed out waiting for query execution"}
kai (Eng): From the logs I'm seeing repeated `Read timed out waiting for results` from analytics workers and a spike in query queue length. Downstream clickhouse shows occasional 504s. Looks like worker saturation + downstream latency.
marco (Infra): Scaling analytics-workers from 8 -> 16 in prod-cluster-a now. Also checking the connection pool change -- might have reduced effective throughput unexpectedly.
jess (Support): After scaling, most charts recovered for org-332 and org-117. org-901 still hits a 502 for big aggregations. Customer sent sample dashboard id 5f3a.
anya (PGM): Can we add a lightweight cached summary fallback for dashboards when analytics returns 5xx? PM request since this affects SLAs.
kai (Eng): Filing infra ticket INF-4529 to track root cause, rollback, and circuit-breaker work. Short-term plan: revert the pool change, add backpressure to gateway, and add a quick cache fallback for heavy queries. Rolling the revert now. :gear:
marco (Infra): Rollback completed at ts 1842107200. Post-rollback error-rate dropped to ~0.6% over 5m. Monitoring for 30m.
jess (Support): I'll patch customers with update and ask for confirmation. Thanks everyone. Will re-open if we see regression. :thumbsup:
